This section is part of NJSC Al-Farabi KazNU's contribution to UN Sustainable Development Goal 4, Quality Education. The University offers open access to its faculty's e-learning resources — lecture courses and video courses in Kazakh, Russian and English. Students, schoolchildren, professionals and lecturers from other universities can learn at their own pace, from anywhere in the world.
